findings.evidence: Lines 256-262: `refine ⟨(InnerProductSpace.toDual 𝕜 _).symm (μ⁻¹ • ((ContinuousMap.evalCLM (R := 𝕜) (M := 𝕜) (1 : G)).comp ((convolutionCLM k).comp (...).subtypeL))), fun h => ?_⟩ ; rw [InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply] ; rfl`. `InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply` (Mathlib/Analysis/InnerProductSpace/Dual.lean:177) leaves `y x` with `y` the composite CLM; the goal's RHS is stated with `*`, the LHS with `•`.
findings.fix: Replace the `rfl` with the explicit named step, e.g. `simp [ContinuousMap.evalCLM_apply, Submodule.subtypeL_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]` (all four exist: `Mathlib/Topology/ContinuousMap/Algebra.lean:622` `@[simps apply] def evalCLM`, `Mathlib/Topology/Algebra/Module/ContinuousLinearMap/Restrict.lean:54` `coe_subtypeL`), or keep `rfl` with a comment stating which unfoldings it goes through and why no lemma route exists.
findings.issue: After `rw [InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply]` the remaining goal `(μ⁻¹ • (evalCLM 1 ∘L convolutionCLM k ∘L subtypeL)) h = μ⁻¹ * convolutionCLM k ↑h 1` is closed by an undocumented bare `rfl`. It silently relies on definitional equality across `ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply`, `ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply`, `ContinuousMap.evalCLM_apply`, `Submodule.subtypeL_apply`, and the `smul_eq_mul` coercion of `•` to `*`. Unlike `rightTranslate_apply_apply` and `rightRegularLp_apply`, this is not a defining equation of a local `def`, so a reader cannot see why it holds, and any of those Mathlib rfl-lemmas becoming non-defeq breaks it with no diagnostic.

summary: Proofs are otherwise robust, well factored and free of change/show; one bare `rfl` closes a substantive goal through four undocumented Mathlib wrapper unfoldings plus a smul/mul defeq.
